description: `AddMongoDB("mongo").WithReplicaSet().WithMongoExpress()` previously left Mongo Express crashing after about 30 seconds because it tried to connect to the replica set's `localhost` member address instead of the server's container-network address. Mongo Express is now configured through a direct connection URL for single-member replica sets, so the two APIs work together without manual connection-string overrides.
name: Fix Mongo Express connection with single-member replica sets
